class.name: OcgShapeupgradeConvertcurve3dtobezier
class.brief_description: converts/splits a 3d curve of any type to a list of beziers
class.description: ! converts/splits a 3d curve of any type to a list of beziers

method.name: SetLineMode
method.description: Sets mode for conversion Geom_Line to bezier.

method.name: SetCircleMode
method.description: Sets mode for conversion Geom_Circle to bezier.

method.name: GetConicMode
method.description: Performs converting and computes the resulting shape.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Converts curve into a list of beziers, and stores the splitting parameters on original curve.

method.name: Build
method.description: Splits a list of beziers computed by Compute method according the split values and splitting parameters.

method.name: SplitParams
method.description: Returns the list of split parameters in original curve parametrisation.
